item.g:title: Neo-Tokyo Cyber Ronin Strike - Classic Graphic T-Shirt
item.g:description:
Official "Neo-Tokyo Cyber Ronin Strike" Classic Graphic T-Shirt on Zazzle.
Designed exclusively for streetwear enthusiasts, graphic collectors, and modern apparel connoisseurs.
PRODUCT SPECIFICATIONS: • Material: 100% Combed Ring-Spun Cotton, Premium Jersey Knit (4.3 oz/yd²). • Print Method: Direct-to-Garment (DTG) archival pigment printing with high color vibrancy and fade resistance. • Construction: Tailored classic crew neck with double-needle hems for maximum longevity. • Fit: Unisex modern regular fit.
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine wash cold inside-out with like colors. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Do not iron over graphic.
AUTHENTICITY & SHIPPING: Produced and fulfilled by Zazzle with full satisfaction guarantee and secure checkout. Fast domestic and international shipping available.
item.g:product_type: Apparel & Accessories > Clothing > Shirts & Tops > T-Shirts
